name: MVTec AD
description: MVTec AD is an industrial anomaly-detection dataset of high-resolution images across object and texture categories, with pixel-precise defect masks for the test set.
citation: Bergmann, P., Fauser, M., Sattlegger, D., and Steger, C. MVTec AD — A Comprehensive Real-World Dataset for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection. CVPR 2019. https://doi.org/10.1109/CVPR.2019.00982
